name: Pertifying Horn
body:
Legend says the horn of an almiraj could petrify a man.

Prerequisite(s): Critical Focus, 11th level, Almiraj, magic horn racial trait

Benefit(s): On a critical hit a creature struck by your magic horn is petrified for 1d4 rounds.
